processes.name: Sales Forecast
processes.description: Multi-horizon sales forecasting process that translates market demand into actionable factory planning signals, directly influencing capacity scheduling, material procurement, and subcontract order placement.

processes.name: Anual Sales Forecast
processes.description: Establishes a high-level 12-month sales projection, serving as the strategic planning baseline for factory capacity reservations, workforce planning, and long-lead material sourcing for the upcoming fiscal year.

processes.name: M+3 Sales plan
processes.description: Generates a rolling 4-month (M+3) sales forecast at a detailed product-family level, providing the tactical demand signal that drives the subsequent subcontract order cycle and raw material purchasing.

processes.name: Create M+3 Subcontract STO
processes.description: Create subcontract Stock Transfer Orders (STO) from the OEM to the factory based on the finalized M+3 sales plan, formally triggering the factory's production and material allocation for the incoming 4th-month window.

processes.name: Maintain M+3 Subcontract STO
processes.description: Adjusts existing subcontract STO quantities to reflect real-time sales performance and current on-hand stock levels, aligning open orders with actual market consumption and preventing over/under-production.

processes.name: Material Requirement Planning
processes.description: Systematic planning engine that nets production schedules and safety-stock policies against on-hand inventories, generating procurement proposals to guarantee production continuity and scrap-replenishment supply.

processes.name: Purchase Requirement Generation
processes.description: Triggers the MRP system to automatically calculate and propose purchase requisitions (PRs) based on net demand from production orders, safety-stock replenishment needs, and existing open purchase commitments.

processes.name: Purchase Requirement Maintenance
processes.description: Enables material planners to manually review, adjust, or create purchase requisitions to capture off-system demands (e.g., engineer change orders, one-off experimental runs, or urgent demand requests) not covered by the standard MRP netting logic.

processes.name: Purchase Execution
processes.description: End-to-end management of procurement workflows, from requisition conversion to supplier settlement, ensuring timely material availability at optimized cost and full trade compliance.

processes.name: PR to PO Creation
processes.description: Converts purchase requisitions into purchase orders by performing source determination, price condition retrieval, and lot-size rounding (upwards to vendor-specified order multiples), ensuring full alignment with production schedules and procurement policies.

processes.name: Consumption PO Creation
processes.description: Generates purchase orders for non-stock / consumable materials (e.g., MRO supplies, indirect goods) based on ad-hoc user requests or predefined consumption triggers, ensuring uninterrupted support for daily production and maintenance activities

processes.name: PO complaince validation
processes.description: Performs mandatory compliance and trade-rule checks on purchase orders prior to approval, mitigating legal, regulatory, and reputational risks.

processes.name: PO Approval
processes.description: Routes purchase orders through the designated authorization workflow for PO release approval.

processes.name: PO Execution
processes.description: Formally transmits approved and released purchase orders to suppliers via the designated channel (e.g., EDI, portal, or email), confirms order acknowledgement, and updates the system with confirmed delivery dates.

processes.name: Invoice Payment
processes.description: Processes supplier invoices against received purchase orders and goods receipts (three-way matching), resolves discrepancies, and executes timely payment in accordance with contractual terms.

processes.name: Inbound Delivery Management
processes.description: End-to-end monitoring and coordination of incoming shipments from supplier dispatch to factory receipt, ensuring full visibility of transit status, regulatory compliance, and timely handover to production warehouses.

processes.name: Inbound Delivery Note Tracking
processes.description: Tracks and maintains all inbound delivery key performance indicators, including supplier dispatch date, shipment tracking number, estimated time of arrival (ETA), customs clearance status, and actual goods receipt date, providing real-time visibility to all downstream stakeholders.

processes.name: Inb DN Custom Cleaning
processes.description: Executes all mandatory customs declaration and clearance procedures for EU-imported goods, ensuring full compliance with trade regulations, tariff classifications, and documentation requirements to avoid border delays and regulatory penalties.

processes.name: Goods Receive DJV
processes.description: Performs system posting of goods receipt (GR) against the corresponding purchase order and inbound delivery, updating inventory records and financial postings immediately upon successful customs clearance and physical reception in container yard.

processes.name: Factory supply transport
processes.description: Plans, schedules, and tracks internal material movements from designated receiving points (Montcada warehouse, Kuehne+Nagel, or the Container Yard) to the respective factory canopy, applying routing rules based on material type to ensure just-in-time (JIT) availability for production operations.

processes.name: Factory Goods Reception
processes.description: End-to-end physical and system processing of incoming materials from factory canopy receipt to buffer warehouse storage, encompassing container inspection, pallet devaning, repackaging, handling unit validation, and put-away, ensuring accurate inventory records and storage-ready condition for production.

processes.name: Container Reception
processes.description: Verifies the incoming container number against the shipping documentation, conducts a visual condition inspection for external damage or seal integrity, and confirms physical reception in the system to officially log arrival.

processes.name: Contianer Devaning
processes.description: Systematically unloads pallets from the container, validates each handling unit number (HU) against the inbound delivery, and physically transfers the pallets to the designated processing area for subsequent handling.

processes.name: Mix Pallet processing
processes.description: Segregates mixed-material pallets into multiple single-material pallets, ensuring correct quantity splits, and prints updated handling unit labels to reflect the newly created unit composition.

processes.name: Handling Unit asessment
processes.description: Assesses each handling unit to determine whether the goods can be stored in their original carton packaging or require repackaging into appropriate storage containers based on material fragility, size, or stacking requirements.

processes.name: Decanting /  Repackaging
processes.description: Transfers goods from original handling units into the appropriate storage handling units (cartons, or bins) as determined by the inspection, and prints new labels to reflect the updated packaging configuration.

processes.name: Put-Away to Buffer Warehouse
processes.description: Moves processed and finalized handling units from the processing area to the designated buffer warehouse storage locations, updating the system with exact bin/rack assignments to enable real-time inventory visibility and downstream picking.

processes.name: Intralogistic Replenishment
processes.description: Systematic intra-factory material replenishment across all storage tiers�from buffer warehouse to kitting areas, SPS stations, and production edgeline�ensuring continuous material availability at the point of use through demand-driven triggers and predefined supply routes.

processes.name: Kitting Area replenishment
processes.description: Transfers handling units of bulk materials from the buffer warehouse to the kitting area,  triggered by minimum stock level thresholds, to ensure uninterrupted assembly kit preparation for production orders.

processes.name: SPS Area replenishment
processes.description: Transfers handling units of bulk materials from the buffer warehouse to the SPS areas,  triggered by minimum stock level thresholds, to maintain continuous feeding of sequenced parts onto AGV racks, which supply the production line in a just-in-sequence flow.

processes.name: Edgeline Repelnishment
processes.description: Transfers handling units of materials from the kitting area, SPS area, or directly from the buffer warehouse to the production edgeline, following a predefined supply path per material (based on consumption patterns, material type, and line-side storage constraints), ensuring just-in-time availability for assembly operations.

processes.name: Production Planning
processes.description: Hierarchical production planning process that translates sales demand and firm subcontract orders into a feasible production schedule, from long-term capacity planning through weekly validation to daily execution monitoring, ensuring optimal line utilization and on-time vehicle delivery.

processes.name: M+3 Production Planning
processes.description: Establishes a rolling production plan covering the current month plus the next three months (M+3), based on the latest sales forecast and confirmed subcontract orders, providing the medium-term view for capacity reservations, workforce planning, and material procurement alignment.

processes.name: Monthlyh production plannig
processes.description: Converts the M+3 production plan into a firm monthly production schedule, aligned with released and confirmed subcontract orders (STOs) from the OEM, defining the precise model mix and quantities to be produced in each production line for the upcoming month.

processes.name: Weekly production validation
processes.description: Validates, freezes, and formally releases a rolling two-week production sequence, incorporating real-time adjustments for material availability, line capacity constraints, and urgent order changes, ensuring a stable and executable schedule for the upcoming two production weeks

processes.name: Daily production monitoring
processes.description: Monitors daily production progress against the planned schedule, tracking key performance indicators (e.g., units produced,  line stoppages), and dynamically adjusts the forecast and sequencing for subsequent days based on actual production results and emerging constraints.

processes.name: Body Shop Production
processes.description: Execution of Body-in-White (BIW) production based on CKD production orders, encompassing MES order generation, quality verification, and handover to the WBS (White Body Storage) system for sequenced supply to Paint Shop operations.

processes.name: Body In White Production
processes.description: Upon receipt of the CKP production vehicle planning schedule, the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) automatically generates and manages BIW production orders, orchestrating the welding, assembly, and quality checks required to produce the bare metal body shell according to the defined model and sequence.

processes.name: BIW Quality Check
processes.description: Performs mandatory quality inspections on each produced BIW shell, verifying dimensional accuracy, weld integrity, and surface quality against defined standards, ensuring that only compliant bodies are released for storage and subsequent Paint Shop processing.

processes.name: WBS Reception
processes.description: System posting and physical handover of quality-approved BIW units into the WBS (White Body Storage) warehouse management system, updating inventory with precise storage location assignments and making the bodies available for sequenced retrieval by Paint Shop consumption.

processes.name: Paint Shop Production
processes.description: Execution of painted body production based on CKD production orders, encompassing MES order generation, paint application, quality verification, and handover to the PBS (Painted Body Storage) system for sequenced supply to Trim Shop operations.

processes.name: Body In Paint Production
processes.description: Upon receipt of the CKP production vehicle planning schedule, the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) automatically generates and manages Paint Shop production orders, orchestrating the surface preparation, primer, base coat, clear coat, and curing processes required to produce the painted body shell according to the defined color and sequence.

processes.name: BIP Quality Check
processes.description: Performs mandatory quality inspections on each produced painted body (BIP), verifying paint thickness, color accuracy, gloss level, and surface defect-free status against defined standards, ensuring that only compliant bodies are released for storage and subsequent Trim Shop processing.

processes.name: PBS RECEPTION
processes.description: System posting and physical handover of quality-approved BIP units into the PBS (Painted Body Storage) warehouse management system, updating inventory with precise storage location assignments and making the bodies available for sequenced retrieval by Trim Shop consumption.

processes.name: Trim Shop Production
processes.description: Assembly execution of painted bodies into complete vehicles, encompassing order execution, critical parts traceability, and offline completion, marking the culmination of the production order lifecycle and handover to final inspection and delivery.

processes.name: Vehicle Production
processes.description: Executes the released production orders, orchestrating the assembly of all trim, chassis, powertrain, electrical, and interior components onto the painted body shell in strict sequence, transforming the BIP into a fully assembled vehicle ready for offline testing.

processes.name: Traceibility of important parts
processes.description: Enforces mandatory traceability controls for specific safety-critical and regulatory key parts (e.g., airbags, engine control units, batteries, VIN plates) assembled into each vehicle, linking each component's serial number and batch data to the unique vehicle identification number (VIN) to ensure full lifecycle traceability and regulatory compliance.

processes.name: Vehicle offline
processes.description: Confirms the vehicle's physical exit from the Trim Shop production line, serving as the formal milestone that marks the successful completion of the production order for that specific vehicle, triggering system updates for inventory, quality, and downstream processes (final inspection, testing, and shipping).

processes.name: Offline vehicle Test
processes.description: Comprehensive post-assembly testing and validation of completed vehicles, encompassing visual inspections, dynamic performance tests, system validations (ADAS, 360� camera, brakes, suspension), paint quality checks, and final buy-off, ensuring all vehicles meet stringent quality and safety standards before dispatch to customers.

processes.name: Overall inspection
processes.description: Performs a comprehensive visual and functional inspection of the completed vehicle, covering exterior fit-and-finish, interior trim, panel gaps, fluid levels, and basic electrical functionality, to identify any visible defects or assembly issues prior to dynamic testing.

processes.name: Test Line Validation
processes.description: Conducts performance tests on the test line, including powertrain, braking system, lighting, and suspension validation, verifying that all critical mechanical and electrical systems operate within specified tolerances and safety parameters.

processes.name: SPT Validation
processes.description: Executes specialized validation of advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), including adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, collision warning, and 360� surround-view camera calibration, ensuring all sensor-based safety systems are correctly configured and fully functional.

processes.name: Plant Gate In (Ready for Dispatch)
processes.description: Confirms the vehicle's physical movement to the designated loading point within the factory premises, marking the vehicle as ready for dispatch to LA CAMPA and triggering system updates for shipping documentation and carrier scheduling.

processes.name: Plant Gate Out (Factory Exit)
processes.description: Confirms the vehicle's physical departure from the factory to LA CAMPA

processes.name: CAMPA Arrival
processes.description: Confirms the vehicle's physical arrival at LA CAMPA, pending final quality confirmation before handover to the commercial network.

processes.name: Dec validation
processes.description: Performs an additional dynamic performance validation (DEC) on the vehicle, focusing on drivability, acceleration, braking feel, and NVH (Noise, Vibration, Harshness) characteristics, ensuring a refined customer driving experience.

processes.name: OK line validation
processes.description: Conducts a final, high-intensity paint and surface quality inspection under specialized lighting conditions, verifying color consistency, gloss uniformity, and the absence of any surface defects (e.g., runs, orange peel, dust inclusions) before customer delivery.

processes.name: Buy-off validation
processes.description: Executes the final buy-off validation, serving as the ultimate quality gate where the vehicle is officially certified as meeting all engineering, safety, regulatory, and customer-specification requirements, authorizing release for commercial sale and customer delivery.

processes.name: Buy off vehicle invoice
processes.description: End-of-month invoicing process for all buy-off validated vehicles, generating customer invoices against their corresponding subcontract orders (STOs) to formalize the commercial transaction and initiate the payment cycle.

processes.name: Vehicle Management
processes.description: End-to-end management of buy-off validated vehicles from factory release to outbound shipment, encompassing physical movement confirmation, compound reception, outbound planning, and dispatch execution, ensuring accurate inventory tracking and timely customer delivery.

processes.name: vehicle buy off
processes.description: Confirms the physical transfer of buy-off validated vehicles to Canopy B (or designated holding area), formally recording the vehicle's release from final quality gates and updating the system status to ""Available for Outbound"" in preparation for customer dispatch.

processes.name: Compound In
processes.description: Confirms the physical arrival and parking of buy-off vehicles at the CAMPA, with the compound operator verifying vehicle identification, condition, and parking location, and updating the yard management system to reflect accurate inventory positioning.

processes.name: Outbound plan
processes.description: Receives and reviews the formal outbound shipment plan from subcontracting OEM, detailing the vehicles scheduled for dispatch, assigned carriers, delivery destinations, and required departure timelines.

processes.name: Compound Out
processes.description: Confirms the physical loading and departure of vehicles from the CAMPA compound onto outbound transport (trucks, rail, or vessel), with the compound operator verifying vehicle identification, carrier documentation, and loading condition, and updating the yard management system with actual dispatch date and time.

processes.name: Outbound plan confirmation
processes.description: Reconciles and updates the outbound plan against actual vehicle movements, capturing real-time dispatch data, adjusting for any deviations (e.g., rescheduled shipments, last-minute order changes), and closing out completed shipments to provide accurate visibility to commercial and logistics stakeholders.
